Anubis and the weighing of the heart
In the Papyrus of Ani, Anubis attends the scales where Ani’s heart is weighed against the feather of Maat.
Karma links actions and consequences across several Indian religious traditions. The accounts of agency, intention and consequences vary by tradition.
Romans 12:17–21 sets out a response to wrongdoing that rejects vengeance and ends with the instruction to overcome evil with good.

Aṅguttara Nikāya 6.63 presents intention as kamma and discusses action through body, speech and mind. This is a Buddhist textual example to read alongside the Egyptian scene and Nathan’s own comparison.
